name.title: Name
name.description: Display name of the catalog, e.g. 'Acme Adapters'.

id.title: Id
id.description: Catalog identifier: lowercase letters, numbers, '-' or '_'. Every node template the catalog ships must prefix its node_type_id with this, uppercased.

ssh_url.title: Ssh Url
ssh_url.description: Where to publish the catalog: the SSH URL of an existing, empty repository, or the absolute path of an existing, empty folder on this server.

local_name.title: Local Name
local_name.description: Directory name to author the catalog under. Defaults to the id.

min_grid_version.title: Min Grid Version
min_grid_version.description: Oldest Grid version that can use this catalog. Empty means any.
